announcements.headline: Change of Auditor
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a change in the firm responsible for auditing the company's financial statements. Such changes are typically administrative governance updates that do not inherently indicate financial distress or operational shifts.

announcements.headline: Interim Results 6 month period ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a scheduled interim results release for the specified six-month period. It provides shareholders with an update on the company's financial performance and operational progress during that timeframe.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or fee ratifications. It signifies standard corporate governance activity with no immediate material financial implications for shareholders.
